items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'Yesterday we ___ to the zoo.'
hints: Yesterday means the past.
Go is a word that changes in the past.
We do not say goed.
items.explanation: The past of go is went: Yesterday we went to the zoo.

options.why: Go does not add -ed. It changes to a new word.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'Last night I ___ a big moon.'
hints: Last night is in the past.
See changes in the past.
The past of see is a short word with three letters.
items.explanation: The past of see is saw.

items.prompt: Match each verb to its past tense.
hints: These verbs change instead of adding -ed.
Say: Today I eat. Yesterday I ___.
Start with run. What did you do yesterday?
items.explanation: Eat becomes ate, run becomes ran, sit becomes sat and come becomes came.

items.prompt: Write the past tense of make.
hints: Make does not add -ed.
Say: Yesterday I ___ a card.
It rhymes with paid.
items.explanation: The past of make is made.

items.prompt: Sort the past tense words.
hints: Look at the end of each word.
Some past words end in -ed. Some change in the middle.
Start with swam. Does it end in -ed?
items.explanation: Jumped, laughed and climbed add -ed. Swam, drank and wrote are changed words.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'This morning I ___ a glass of milk.'
hints: This morning has already happened.
Drink changes in the past.
Think of sing and sang. Drink changes the same way.
items.explanation: The past of drink is drank.

items.prompt: Write the past tense of ride. 'Kemal ___ his bike to the shop.'
hints: Ride does not add -ed.
The i changes to another vowel.
It rhymes with code.
items.explanation: The past of ride is rode.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
hints: The sentence is about the past.
Sing changes in the past.
Think of drink and drank.
items.explanation: The past of sing is sang: She sang a song.

options.why: Sung needs a helper word, like has sung.

items.prompt: Choose all the past tense verbs. 'I woke up, ate my breakfast and ran to school.'
hints: Three words are right.
Look for the doing words.
What did I do? Find three actions.
items.explanation: Woke, ate and ran are past tense verbs.

options.why: Up is not a doing word.

items.prompt: Change it to the past. 'Today I write a letter.' becomes 'Yesterday I ___ a letter.'
hints: Write does not add -ed.
The i changes to o.
It rhymes with boat.
items.explanation: The past of write is wrote.

items.prompt: What is the past tense of fly?
hints: Fly changes in the past.
Think of grow and grew.
It rhymes with blue.
items.explanation: The past of fly is flew: The bird flew away.

options.why: Flown needs a helper word, like has flown.

items.prompt: What is the past tense of catch?
hints: Catch changes in the past.
It rhymes with taught.
It has a silent g and h.
items.explanation: The past of catch is caught. It has au and a silent gh.

items.prompt: One word fits both gaps. Write it. 'Yesterday I ___ a book. Today I will ___ a comic.'
hints: The word is spelt the same in both gaps.
It sounds different in the past.
What do you do with a book and a comic?
items.explanation: Read is spelt the same in the past and now. In the past, it sounds like red.

items.prompt: Which sentence is in the past?
hints: The past means it already happened.
Buy changes in the past.
Look for the special past word.
items.explanation: Bought is the past of buy, so Dad bought some bread is in the past.

items.prompt: Fix the mistake. 'We goed to the beach.' Write the right word.
hints: Goed is not a real word.
Go has a special past word.
It starts with w.
items.explanation: The past of go is went: We went to the beach.

items.prompt: Which word has a past tense that rhymes with caught?
hints: Find the past of each verb.
Say the past word, then say caught.
The four verbs rhyme now. Do their past words rhyme too?
items.explanation: The past of think is thought, which rhymes with caught.

items.prompt: Choose the words to finish. 'Yesterday Ana ___ her friend a card, and her friend ___ it on the wall.'
hints: Both gaps are in the past.
Give changes in the past.
Put does not change at all in the past.
items.explanation: The past of give is gave. Put stays the same: put.

options.why: Give and put do not add -ed.
Put stays the same in the past.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'I ___ a cold yesterday, so I stayed in bed.'
hints: Yesterday is in the past.
Have changes in the past.
It is a short word with three letters.
items.explanation: The past of have is had.

items.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence about the past.
hints: The sentence starts with words that tell you when.
The doing word changes in the past. It does not end in -ed.
Think about the past of buy.
items.explanation: Last week Mum bought some mangoes. The past of buy is bought.
items.answer: Last week Mum bought some mangoes.

items.prompt: Last night I ___ my dinner and then I ___ to bed.
hints: Last night means the past.
Some past tense words do not end in -ed.
Say the sentence aloud with each choice. Which one sounds right?
items.explanation: Ate is the past of eat and went is the past of go. They are irregular, so they do not end in -ed.
